full_judgment:
3. The petitioner as defendant contested the suit by filing written statement denying most of the allegations of the plaint. He contended that the suit is barred by limitation and not maintainable in its present form and manner inasmuch as the petitioner after solemnization of the marriage gave ornaments of gold weighing 5 tola, land, cash Tk. 30,000/= etc. The petitioner also contended that the plaintiff was found to be desperate in character and she was given in marriage twice before marriage with him. The petitioner divorced her on 1.4.2007, the plaintiff is not entitled to get any relief. The suit is liable to be dismissed. 

 (ii) Whether the suit is barred by limitation?
